The other dashboards in this repository

Several sessions built dashboards in parallel. This pass publishes a verified one, but it did not remove the others: they are listed here so you can compare them and so nothing is hidden. Where their numbers could not be verified, that is stated next to the link — that is the only editorialising done here.

Why keep them

Deleting another session's work to make a build pass would destroy evidence. Keeping them next to a clear verification label lets you see exactly which numbers came from the exchange and which did not — which is the whole point of the exercise.

If you are comparing: open any row in a dashboard and check whether the market ticker it shows returns a real market at https://external-api.demo.kalshi.co/trade-api/v2/markets/<ticker>. If it returns 404, the row was not read from the API. That single check separates the verified table from the placeholder one.
